reviews.review: I like the look: each stage has its own colour and the ghost is easy to see. First Steps and Crumble Bridge feel friendly, and Laser Gate is clear because I can see which beams are on. But Spring Loaded stops me dead. My ghost stands next to a spring in front of a long spike row for 45 seconds and nobody out of 100 gets past, so I would never see stages 7 and 8. Saw Mill also comes too early: saws float everywhere and I die in five seconds. Ferry Lines has many falls for a stage with almost no hazards.
reviews.best: Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate are readable, pretty and beatable with a little care.
reviews.worst: Spring Loaded is impossible, the spring before the spike row does not get anyone across, so the game ends at stage 6.

reviews.review: I like the one-mechanic-per-stage structure: First Steps teaches gaps and one spike pair, Spike Garden builds on it, and Gauntlet remixes everything as a proper final exam. Laser Gate and Crumble Bridge read clearly and sit in a fair band. But Spring Loaded is broken: all 100 ghosts stall at the first spring before the spike field, so the spring is never taught and the stage cannot be finished. Saw Mill spikes too early for stage 3, with many drifting saws and deaths spread over the plateau. Ferry Lines loses 43 players to pits with no visible cue for platform timing.
reviews.best: Gauntlet combines saws, crumble tiles, ferries, a spring and lasers in a readable final exam with a 60% pass rate.
reviews.worst: Spring Loaded is impossible: nobody gets past the first spring at 38%, so the game cannot be completed.

reviews.review: Spring Loaded kills this build for me: all 100 ghosts stall at the second spring in front of the long spike row and time out, so no run can be completed. That is a hard blocker, not a difficulty problem. The rest has good flow. Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate are fast, readable and punish only bad timing. Gauntlet mixes every mechanic well, but the laser there killed the high-skill player, which looks like a cycle I cannot read early enough. Saw Mill kills at 50% with drifting saws that look partly random. First Steps is flat and slow.
reviews.best: Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate give fast, readable routes where each death is the fault of the player.
reviews.worst: Spring Loaded cannot be finished by anyone: every ghost is stuck at the spring before the spike row.

git.subject: v6: second balance pass; stages 1 and 6 made HARDER
git.body:
Measurement (v5), mid-skill pass: stage 1 86.7% and stage 6 100% (too
easy); stage 2 52.7%, stage 3 36.0%, stage 4 53.3%, stage 8 34.0% (too hard).
Harder:
- stage 1: gap at tile 47 3 -> 4 tiles; single spike at tile 38 -> 2 spikes.
- stage 6: 0 deaths in 500 runs. Spikes after pad 3: 5 -> 6 tiles (pad
  flight about 218 px, 6 spikes need about 200 px). New bobbing saw in the
  flight path between pad 4 and pad 5.
Easier:
- stage 2: 48 deaths at the 3 spikes at tile 15: 3 -> 2 spikes.
- stage 3: patrol saws period 160 -> 220 and 120 -> 180; saw over the gap
  at tile 30 moved 1 tile up, period 150 -> 180.
- stage 4: 58 saw deaths on the last ferry: saw period 180 -> 240, the same
  as the ferry, so the saw is up when the ferry goes below it.
  Second twin ferry starts 0.5 tile nearer.
- stage 8: 62 laser deaths at tile 64 (35 high-skill; no room to stop
  after the crumble tiles): run before the laser 3 -> 5 tiles, period
  90 -> 120. Patrol saw at tiles 69-71 (78 deaths) -> one bobbing saw.
